en.name: Hammersmith Bridge
en.text: A magnificent Grade II listed suspension bridge over the Thames, designed by Sir Joseph Bazalgette.

en.name: Eventim Apollo
en.text: A legendary Art Deco music venue hosting world-famous bands and comedians in a spectacular setting.

en.name: Lyric Hammersmith
en.text: A renowned producing theatre featuring a Victorian auditorium and a modern rooftop terrace garden.

en.name: Kelmscott House
en.text: The former home of William Morris, now a museum dedicated to his life and the Arts and Crafts movement.

en.name: Ravenscourt Park
en.text: A large public park with a walled garden, lake, and various sports facilities, popular with local residents.

en.name: The Dove
en.text: A historic 17th-century riverside pub with a tiny bar area and a terrace offering views of the Thames.

en.name: Riverside Studios
en.text: A modern arts center hosting independent films, television recordings, and contemporary theatre.

en.name: St Paul's Church
en.text: A significant Victorian Gothic church situated near the bridge, known for its active community and spire.

en.name: Hammersmith Town Hall
en.text: An impressive 1930s brick building serving as the administrative center with a grand assembly hall.

en.name: Furnivall Gardens
en.text: A riverside green space on the site of old housing, popular for sunbathing and watching the Boat Race.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Hammersmith, gelegen im westlichen Teil Londons entlang der Themse, ist ein bedeutender urbaner Knotenpunkt. Die historische Hammersmith Bridge, ein architektonisch bemerkenswertes Bauwerk, prägt das Stadtbild ebenso wie die vielfältigen kulturellen Einrichtungen, darunter das berühmte Hammersmith Apollo. Der Stadtteil verbindet erfolgreich historisches Erbe mit modernen geschäftlichen Entwicklungen und beherbergt zahlreiche Firmensitze. Die Uferpromenaden bieten eine Oase der Ruhe mitten im geschäftigen London und sind ein beliebter Treffpunkt für Einwohner. Mit seiner exzellenten Verkehrsanbindung und dem dynamischen kulturellen Leben gilt Hammersmith als einer der begehrtesten Wohn- und Arbeitsstandorte in der britischen Hauptstadt.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Hammersmith Nyugat-London egyik legdinamikusabb és legforgalmasabb központja, amely közvetlenül a Temze partján fekszik. A kerület jelképe a viktoriánus stílusú Hammersmith híd, amely zöldre festett vaskonstrukciójával összeköti a területet Barnes kerületével. Hammersmith kulturális jelentősége kiemelkedő, hiszen itt található a világhírű Eventim Apollo koncertterem és a Lyric Theatre, amelyek neves nemzetközi fellépőknek adnak otthont. A folyóparti sétány, a Hammersmith Terrace mentén számos történelmi pub és evezősklub sorakozik, ahol a látogatók átélhetik a hamisítatlan londoni hangulatot. A városrész fontos gazdasági csomópont is, több multinacionális vállalat központja található itt. A nyüzsgő King Street vásárlási lehetőségei és a csendesebb folyóparti parkok közötti kontraszt teszi Hammersmithet London egyik legsokszínűbb negyedévé.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Hammersmith, situat în partea de vest a Londrei de-a lungul Tamisei, este un punct nodal urban important. Istoricul Hammersmith Bridge, o construcție notabilă din punct de vedere arhitectural, definește peisajul urban la fel de mult ca și diversele instituții culturale, inclusiv faimosul Hammersmith Apollo. Districtul combină cu succes moștenirea istorică cu dezvoltările moderne de afaceri și găzduiește numeroase sedii de companii. Promenadele de pe malul râului oferă o oază de liniște în mijlocul Londrei agitate și sunt un loc de întâlnire popular pentru rezidenți. Cu conexiunile sale excelente de transport și viața culturală dinamică, Hammersmith este considerat unul dintre cele mai râvnite locuri de locuit și lucrat din capitala britanică.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Hammersmith, situated in the western part of London along the River Thames, is an important urban hub. The historical Hammersmith Bridge, an architecturally remarkable structure, defines the townscape just as much as the diverse cultural venues, including the famous Hammersmith Apollo. The district successfully combines historical heritage with modern business developments and is home to numerous corporate headquarters. The riverside promenades offer an oasis of calm in the middle of busy London and are a popular meeting point for residents. With its excellent transport links and dynamic cultural life, Hammersmith is considered one of the most sought-after residential and working locations in the British capital.
